function RotatingWord(_ref6) {
  var words = _ref6.words,
    _ref6$interval = _ref6.interval,
    interval = _ref6$interval === void 0 ? 2200 : _ref6$interval;
  var _React$useState3 = React.useState(0),
    _React$useState4 = _slicedToArray(_React$useState3, 2),
    idx = _React$useState4[0],
    setIdx = _React$useState4[1];
  React.useEffect(function () {
    var t = setTimeout(function () {
      return setIdx((idx + 1) % words.length);
    }, interval);
    return function () {
      return clearTimeout(t);
    };
  }, [idx, words.length, interval]);
  var widest = React.useMemo(function () {
    return words.reduce(function (a, b) {
      return a.length > b.length ? a : b;
    }, "");
  }, [words]);
  return /*#__PURE__*/React.createElement("span", {
    className: "fc-rotator",
    "aria-live": "polite"
  }, /*#__PURE__*/React.createElement("span", {
    className: "fc-rotator__ghost"
  }, widest), words.map(function (w, i) {
    return /*#__PURE__*/React.createElement("span", {
      key: i,
      className: "fc-rotator__word" + (i === idx ? " is-active" : i === (idx - 1 + words.length) % words.length ? " is-leaving" : "")
    }, w);
  }));
}

/* ============================================================
   APP — hash router
   ============================================================ */
var ROUTES = {
  "home": HomePage,
  "como-funciona": ComoFuncionaPage,
  "sobre": SobrePage,
  "unidades": UnidadesPage,
  "faq": FaqPage,
  "franquia": FranquiaPage
};
var PATH_TO_ROUTE = {
  "/como-funciona": "como-funciona",
  "/sobre-nos": "sobre",
  "/unidades": "unidades",
  "/central-de-ajuda": "faq",
  "/seja-um-franqueado": "franquia"
};
var ROUTE_TO_PATH = {
  "como-funciona": "/como-funciona",
  "sobre": "/sobre-nos",
  "unidades": "/unidades",
  "faq": "/central-de-ajuda",
  "franquia": "/seja-um-franqueado"
};
function resolveInitialPage() {
  return "unidades";
  var path = window.location.pathname.replace(/\/$/, "") || "/";
  if (PATH_TO_ROUTE[path]) return PATH_TO_ROUTE[path];
  var hash = (window.location.hash || "").replace("#", "");
  return ROUTES[hash] ? hash : "home";
}
function App() {
  var _React$useState9 = React.useState(resolveInitialPage),
    _React$useState0 = _slicedToArray(_React$useState9, 2),
    page = _React$useState0[0],
    setPage = _React$useState0[1];
  React.useEffect(function () {
    var onHash = function onHash() {
      var id = (window.location.hash || "#home").replace("#", "");
      if (ROUTES[id]) setPage(id);
    };
    window.addEventListener("hashchange", onHash);
    return function () {
      return window.removeEventListener("hashchange", onHash);
    };
  }, []);
  var handleNav = function handleNav(id) {
    if (!ROUTES[id]) return;
    var target = ROUTE_TO_PATH[id] || "/";
    window.location.href = target;
  };
  var Page = ROUTES[page] || HomePage;
  return /*#__PURE__*/React.createElement(React.Fragment, null, /*#__PURE__*/React.createElement(Nav, {
    current: page,
    onNav: handleNav
  }), /*#__PURE__*/React.createElement("main", {
    key: page,
    className: "page-transition"
  }, /*#__PURE__*/React.createElement(Page, {
    onNav: handleNav
  })), /*#__PURE__*/React.createElement(Footer, {
    onNav: handleNav
  }));
}
var root = ReactDOM.createRoot(document.getElementById("root"));
root.render(/*#__PURE__*/React.createElement(App, null));
//# sourceMappingURL=data:application/json;charset=utf-8;base64,</script></head>

function MS({ name, size=24, fill=0, weight=400, style }) {
  return (
    <span className="material-symbols-outlined"

        fontFamily:"'Material Symbols Outlined'",

        verticalAlign:"middle",
        userSelect:"none",
        textTransform:"none",
        letterSpacing:"normal",
        fontVariationSettings:`'FILL' ${fill},'wght' ${weight},'GRAD' 0,'opsz' 24`,
        ...style
      }}
      aria-hidden="true">{name}</span>
  );
}

const NAV_ITEMS = [

function Nav({ current, onNav }) {
  const [mobileOpen,setMobileOpen] = React.useState(false);
  const go = (id) => {
    onNav(id);
    setMobileOpen(false);
  };
  return (
    <React.Fragment>
      <nav className="fc-nav">
        <a href="#home" className="fc-nav__brand"
           onClick={(e)=>{e.preventDefault();go("home");}}
           aria-label="Flash Car Store — Início">
          <img src={LOGO_RED_BOX} alt="Flash Car Store"/>
        </a>
        <div className="fc-nav__links">
          {NAV_ITEMS.map((item)=>(
            <a key={item.id} href={item.href}
               aria-current={current===item.id?"page":undefined}
               className={"fc-nav__link"+(current===item.id?" fc-nav__link--active":"")}>
              {item.label}
            </a>
          ))}
        </div>
        <a href="https://flashcar.store/nossas-unidades" className="fc-btn fc-btn--primary fc-nav__cta">
          Agendar avaliação
        </a>
        <button type="button" className="fc-nav__menu-btn" aria-label={mobileOpen?"Fechar menu":"Abrir menu"} aria-expanded={mobileOpen}
                onClick={()=>setMobileOpen((open)=>!open)}>
          <MS name={mobileOpen?"close":"menu"} size={26}/>
        </button>
      </nav>
      {mobileOpen&&(
        <div className="fc-nav-mobile" aria-label="Menu mobile">
          {NAV_ITEMS.map((item)=>(
            <a key={item.id} href={item.href}
               aria-current={current===item.id?"page":undefined}>
              {item.label}
            </a>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
    </React.Fragment>
  );
}

/* Rotating word hero animation */
function RotatingWord({ words, interval=2200 }) {
  const [idx,setIdx] = React.useState(0);
  React.useEffect(()=>{
    const t = setTimeout(()=>setIdx((idx+1)%words.length),interval);
    return ()=>clearTimeout(t);
  },[idx,words.length,interval]);
  const widest = React.useMemo(()=>words.reduce((a,b)=>a.length>b.length?a:b,""),[words]);
  return (
    <span className="fc-rotator" aria-live="polite">
      <span className="fc-rotator__ghost">{widest}</span>
      {words.map((w,i)=>(
        <span key={i} className={"fc-rotator__word"+(i===idx?" is-active":(i===(idx-1+words.length)%words.length?" is-leaving":""))}>
          {w}
        </span>
      ))}
    </span>
  );
}

function StepCard({ num, icon, title, body, active }) {
  return (
    <div className={"fc-step"+(active?" fc-step--active":"")}>
      <div className="fc-step__icon"><MS name={icon} size={18} fill={1}/></div>
      <div className="fc-step__num">{num}</div>
      <h4 style={{margin:"0 0 4px",font:"700 17px var(--font-display)"}}>{title}</h4>
      <p style={{margin:0,font:"400 14px/1.55 var(--font-body)",color:active?"rgba(255,255,255,0.85)":"var(--fg-muted)"}}>{body}</p>
    </div>
  );
}

function VehicleType({ icon, name, body }) {
  return (
    <div style={{textAlign:"center",padding:32,background:"rgba(255,255,255,0.06)",border:"1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.10)",borderRadius:16,backdropFilter:"blur(12px)"}}>
      <div style={{width:72,height:72,borderRadius:18,background:"rgba(216,38,42,0.25)",color:"var(--fc-yellow)",display:"grid",placeItems:"center",margin:"0 auto 16px"}}>
        <MS name={icon} size={38} weight={400}/>
      </div>
      <h3 style={{font:"700 20px var(--font-display)",margin:"0 0 8px",color:"white"}}>{name}</h3>
      <p style={{font:"400 14px/1.55 var(--font-body)",color:"rgba(255,255,255,0.65)",margin:0}}>{body}</p>
    </div>
  );
}

/* ── UNIDADES ─────────────────────────────────────────────── */
const UNITS = (window.FLASHCAR_UNITS || []).map((u, index)=>({
  slug:u.slug,
  city:u.nome,
  uf:u.uf,
  flag:u.flag || (index === 0 ? "Unidade oficial" : null),
  flagKind:u.flag ? "soft-yellow" : index === 0 ? "red" : null,
  addr:u.endereco,
  hours:u.horario,
  phone:u.telefone || ("+" + u.whatsapp),
  photo:u.foto,
}));

function UnitCard({ u }) {
  const flagCls = {"red":"fc-badge fc-badge--red","soft-yellow":"fc-badge fc-badge--soft-yellow","soft-green":"fc-badge fc-badge--soft-green"};
  return (
    <article className="fc-unit-card">
      <div className="fc-unit-card__media">
        {u.photo ? (
          <img src={u.photo} alt={"Flash Car " + u.city} loading="lazy"/>
        ) : (
          <div style={{width:"100%",height:"100%",background:"linear-gradient(135deg,var(--fc-navy-800),var(--fc-navy-900))",display:"grid",placeItems:"center",color:"rgba(255,255,255,0.3)",font:"600 12px var(--font-display)",letterSpacing:"0.1em",textTransform:"uppercase"}}>
          <MS name="storefront" size={48} weight={300}/>
          </div>
        )}
        {u.flag&&<div className="fc-unit-card__flag"><span className={flagCls[u.flagKind||"red"]}>{u.flag}</span></div>}
      </div>
      <div className="fc-unit-card__body">
        <div className="fc-unit-card__title">Flash Car {u.city} / {u.uf}</div>
        <div className="fc-unit-card__meta"><MS name="place" size={16} fill={1}/>{u.addr}</div>
        <div className="fc-unit-card__meta"><MS name="schedule" size={16}/>{u.hours}</div>
        <div className="fc-unit-card__meta"><MS name="call" size={16} fill={1}/>{u.phone}</div>
        <a href={"/"+u.slug} className="fc-btn fc-btn--dark fc-btn--block fc-unit-card__cta">
          <MS name="arrow_forward" size={16}/> Ver esta unidade
        </a>
      </div>
    </article>
  );
}

function UnidadesPage({ onNav }) {
  const [filter,setFilter] = React.useState("Todos");
  const states = ["Todos","SC","PR","RS","SP"];
  const visible = filter==="Todos"?UNITS:UNITS.filter(u=>u.uf===filter);
  return (
    <React.Fragment>
      <header className="page-header" style={{background:"var(--fc-navy-900)"}}>
        <div className="page-header__video-bg">
          {React.createElement('video',{ref:el=>{if(el){el.muted=true;el.play&&el.play().catch(()=>{})}},autoPlay:true,loop:true,playsInline:true,preload:"auto"},React.createElement('source',{src:"../assets/flashcar-hero.mp4",type:"video/mp4"}))}
        </div>
        <div className="page-header__video-overlay"/>
        <div className="page-header__inner">
          <span className="fc-eyebrow">Rede nacional</span>
          <h1>Encontre a Flash Car mais perto de você</h1>
          <p>Estamos presentes nas principais regiões do país. Atendimento presencial com avaliação gratuita e pagamento via PIX no mesmo dia.</p>
        </div>
      </header>
      <div className="units-filterbar">
        <div className="units-filterbar__inner">
          <span className="units-filterbar__label">Filtrar por estado:</span>
          {states.map(s=>(
            <button key={s} className={"fc-pill"+(filter===s?" fc-pill--active":"")} onClick={()=>setFilter(s)}>{s}</button>
          ))}
          <div style={{marginLeft:"auto",display:"flex",alignItems:"center",gap:8,color:"var(--fg-muted)",fontSize:13}}>
            <MS name="place" size={16}/>{visible.length} unidade{visible.length!==1?"s":""}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <section className="section" style={{paddingTop:48,background:"white"}}>
        <div className="section__inner">
          <div className="grid-3">
            {visible.map(u=><UnitCard key={u.city+u.uf} u={u}/>)}
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>
      <ConversionCard
        title="Quer vender seu veículo com mais segurança?"
        body="Nossos consultores estão prontos para oferecer uma avaliação justa e todo o suporte necessário."
        primary={{label:"Encontrar minha unidade",href:"https://flashcar.store/nossas-unidades"}}
        secondary={{label:"Agendar agora",target:"home"}}
        onNav={onNav}/>
    </React.Fragment>
  );
}

const MARKET_YEARS = [
  {y:"2020",v:11.3},{y:"2021",v:12.8},{y:"2022",v:13.9},

function PillarCard({ kicker, title, body, icon, tone }) {
  const accents = {red:{bg:"var(--fc-danger-soft)",fg:"var(--fc-red)"},yellow:{bg:"var(--fc-warning-soft)",fg:"#6B5800"},green:{bg:"var(--fc-success-soft)",fg:"var(--fc-green-deep)"}};
  const c = accents[tone]||accents.red;
  return (
    <div className="fc-card fc-card--lift" style={{display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",gap:12}}>
      <div style={{width:52,height:52,borderRadius:14,background:c.bg,color:c.fg,display:"grid",placeItems:"center"}}>
        <MS name={icon} size={28} fill={1}/>
      </div>
      <div style={{font:"700 11px var(--font-display)",letterSpacing:"0.12em",textTransform:"uppercase",color:"var(--fg-muted)"}}>{kicker}</div>
      <h3 style={{font:"800 22px var(--font-display)",margin:0,color:"var(--fg-strong)",letterSpacing:"-0.01em"}}>{title}</h3>
      <p style={{font:"400 15px/1.6 var(--font-body)",color:"var(--fg-muted)",margin:0}}>{body}</p>
    </div>
  );
}

function KPIInline({ value, body, accent }) {
  return (
    <div className="market-kpi" style={{"--kpi-accent":accent}}>
      <div className="market-kpi__value">{value}</div>
      <div className="market-kpi__body">{body}</div>
    </div>
  );
}

        <div className="testi__avatar">{initial}</div>
        <div>
          <div className="testi__name">{name}</div>
          <div className="testi__role">{role}</div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function FaqItem({ q, a }) {
  const [open,setOpen] = React.useState(false);
  return (
    <div style={{border:"1px solid",borderRadius:12,background:"white",transition:"border-color 200ms,box-shadow 200ms",borderColor:open?"var(--fc-red)":"var(--fc-ink-200)",boxShadow:open?"var(--shadow-sm)":"none"}}>
      <button onClick={()=>setOpen(!open)} aria-expanded={open}
              style={{width:"100%",background:"transparent",border:0,padding:"18px 20px",display:"flex",alignItems:"center",justifyContent:"space-between",gap:16,cursor:"pointer",textAlign:"left",font:"700 16px var(--font-display)",color:"var(--fg-strong)"}}>
        <span>{q}</span>
        <span style={{width:32,height:32,borderRadius:"50%",background:open?"var(--fc-red)":"var(--fc-ink-100)",color:open?"white":"var(--fg-strong)",display:"grid",placeItems:"center",transition:"all 200ms",flexShrink:0}}>
          <MS name={open?"remove":"add"} size={16} weight={600}/>
        </span>
      </button>
      {open&&<div style={{padding:"0 20px 22px",font:"400 15px/1.6 var(--font-body)",color:"var(--fg-default)"}}>{a}</div>}
    </div>
  );
}

/* ============================================================
   APP — hash router
   ============================================================ */
const ROUTES = {
  "home":          HomePage,
  "como-funciona": ComoFuncionaPage,
  "sobre":         SobrePage,
  "unidades":      UnidadesPage,
  "faq":           FaqPage,
  "franquia":      FranquiaPage,
};

const PATH_TO_ROUTE = {
  "/como-funciona":      "como-funciona",
  "/sobre-nos":              "sobre",
  "/unidades":           "unidades",
  "/central-de-ajuda":   "faq",
  "/seja-um-franqueado": "franquia",
};

const ROUTE_TO_PATH = {
  "como-funciona": "/como-funciona",
  "sobre":         "/sobre-nos",
  "unidades":      "/unidades",
  "faq":           "/central-de-ajuda",
  "franquia":      "/seja-um-franqueado",
};

function resolveInitialPage() { return "unidades";
  var path = window.location.pathname.replace(/\/$/,"") || "/";
  if (PATH_TO_ROUTE[path]) return PATH_TO_ROUTE[path];
  var hash = (window.location.hash||"").replace("#","");
  return ROUTES[hash] ? hash : "home";
}

function App() {
  const [page,setPage] = React.useState(resolveInitialPage);

  React.useEffect(()=>{
    const onHash = ()=>{
      const id = (window.location.hash||"#home").replace("#","");
      if (ROUTES[id]) setPage(id);
    };
    window.addEventListener("hashchange",onHash);
    return ()=>window.removeEventListener("hashchange",onHash);
  },[]);

  const handleNav = (id)=>{
    if (!ROUTES[id]) return;
    var target = ROUTE_TO_PATH[id] || "/";
    window.location.href = target;
  };

  const Page = ROUTES[page]||HomePage;
  return (
    <React.Fragment>
      <Nav current={page} onNav={handleNav}/>
      <main key={page} className="page-transition"><Page onNav={handleNav}/></main>
      <Footer onNav={handleNav}/>
    </React.Fragment>
  );
}

const root = ReactDOM.createRoot(document.getElementById("root"));
root.render(<App/>);
</script>
